title: Concrete coefficient projection data
statement: Concrete coefficient projection data. These are the actual functors and ordered comparisons of the concrete finite-reduction square, with normalized scalar adjunctions and tensor models [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data] and compact-support coefficient data [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. The quotient maps use the actual coefficient-extension rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
